decisions.reason: A complete same-message MODIFY already records the detailed mismatch-description and pre-generation clarification process for SQ4.
A complete same-message MODIFY already records the detailed mismatch-description and pre-generation clarification process for SQ11.
A complete same-message MODIFY already captures the project-level storyboard-mismatch specification and permission for pre-generation clarification.
The source establishes a shot-specification communication process but does not change the required appearance or behavior of the SQ4 energy blast.
The source does not change image-quality standards, permitted quality improvements, or the precedence rule already governing shot-angle adjustments.
The mismatch-description process has no effect on the requirement that the final video be in full color.
The source does not alter the final video's vertical orientation or 9:16 aspect ratio.
The source defines how future storyboard mismatches will be described but does not revise the established character-pair framing order or composition.
The source does not change the requirement that new sets remain stylistically consistent across shots.
The source does not change the requirement that revised sets remain visually distinct from one another.
The source does not alter the content, priority, or deferred lifecycle of the opening aerial establishing shot.
The source does not change which bridges must be removed or retained in the Kestrel images.
